players_tracked_method: Page text did not print players-tracked. Estimated from rate quantisation: every rate is count/N rounded to 2dp; integer earner counts consistent across trophies (platinum 4 -> 0.03%, Ch1 88 -> 0.73%, Beat Cal 227 -> 1.89%, arcade 49 -> 0.41%) all imply N in ~(11980, 12040]. So N ~= 12,000, up from 3,868 at 04:30Z and 638 on launch night.
source: Exophase GTA VI PS5 trophy page, https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/, crawled 2026-11-19 14:48 UTC. Rates in kit trophy-id order (page order matches kit order, verified description by description).
vs_0430z_refresh: N 3,868 -> ~12,000 (3.1x dilution). Most rates fell ~3-4x (earners flat: story missions 0.23% -> 0.06%, platinum 0.10% -> 0.03%). Risers against dilution: Ch1 0.49% -> 0.73% (earners 19 -> ~88), Beat Cal 1.16% -> 1.89% (45 -> ~227), arcade 0.39% -> 0.41%, Breakfast Run 0.23% -> 0.24%. Gone Fishing 100% -> 99.99% (first non-earner tracked).
